out.title: Group General Counsel Sudhir Kumar Jha retires; Jigar Shah appointed General Counsel
out.summary: Sudhir Kumar Jha, Group Head - Legal & Group General Counsel, superannuated effective September 30, 2026 after 22 years; Jigar Shah assumes General Counsel role from October 1, 2026.

person.name: Sudhir Kumar Jha
person.role: Group Head - Legal & Group General Counsel
person.bio: Group Head - Legal & Group General Counsel; 22 years with HDFC Group including HDFC Ltd and the Bank; strengthened legal and compliance framework.
